_meta.purpose: Seed anchors until re-db/builds/<build>/anchors.yaml exists. 'signature' fields are filled by `gta6mod anchors sign` from the user's own exe and checked by `gta6mod anchors verify`.
_meta.naming: Names describe the ROLE we observed. Names with a rage:: prefix are inferred by analogy with GTA V/RDR2 and say so in 'confidence'.
_meta.resolve: kind=function|code: the anchor is the match address (+offset). kind=data|vtable: the match is an instruction with a RIP-relative operand; 'rip' = {disp_at, insn_len} gives the target.
